import sys, time, random, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, topo, algo
rng=random.Random(11)
# moderate scale: N=64, P=16, several slices
N=64; T=100; S=100; Q=16
P=topo.period_rounds(T,S,Q)
print('P',P)
links=[]
for i in range(32):
    a=rng.randrange(N); b=rng.randrange(N)
    if a==b: continue
    links.append({'ends':[[a,0,0],[b,0,0]],'delay_ns':[rng.randint(1,50),rng.randint(1,50)],'defer_rounds':[rng.randint(0,2),rng.randint(0,2)]})
slices=[[] for _ in range(Q)]
for i,l in enumerate(links): slices[i%Q].append(i)
fabric={'n':N,'interval_ns':T,'slice_ns':S,'offset_ns':0,'drift_ppb':[rng.choice([0,1,2]) for _ in range(N)],
        'heat':[[0,1,3,5],[5,2,4,3]],'anchors':[[i%8,0,2] for i in range(N)],
        'links':links,'slices':slices,'blackouts':[[0,1,3]],'guards_ns':[0,1,2,3],'reconfig_ns':0}
prof={'groups':1,'jitter_ps':[0],'measurements':[]}
t0=time.time(); plan=algo.compile_plan(prof,fabric); t1=time.time()
print('plan %.2fs guard=%s peaks=%s'%(t1-t0, plan['guard_ns'], plan['peaks_as']))
t0=time.time(); a=algo.audit(prof,fabric,plan); t1=time.time()
print('audit %.2fs -> %s'%(t1-t0,a))
print('warmup', plan['warmup_cycle'], 'bounds row0', plan['bounds_as'][0][:6], 'ages row0', plan['age_rounds'][0][:6])
print(json.dumps(plan['pred'][0][:4]))
EOF
